limits: Discovery cohorts are current classification candidates, not dated field memberships.
Broad gender/women's studies discovery additionally requires the exact historian occupation Q201788.
Authority links remain unreviewed candidates; IdRef names and birth values are retained for review.
Bibliographic sampling is deterministic by hashed QID and includes available controls; it is not a representative sample of the profession.
Only Sudoc resources with the specified contribution roles are harvested; theses and other linked corpora are out of scope.
All publication years are retained for sampled authorities; recent exports use exact structured years, never years parsed from titles.
A 2026 year is catalogued metadata, not verification that a publication has already appeared.
No source subject becomes an author specialism, approach or influence claim. No first-publication dates are inferred.
